PostToolUse.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then black --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.{js,ts,jsx,tsx} ]]; then npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.go ]]; then gofmt -w "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
